analyzed_vuln.description: The root cause is missing validity/sanitization checks before traversing COLRv1 paint graphs during subsetting. In COLR::closure_forV1(), code iterates BaseGlyphV1 records and directly resolves `const Paint &paint = &baseglyphV1_records + baseglyphV1record.paint;` then calls `paint.dispatch(&c)` without confirming the referenced paint offset points to in-bounds table data. This allows an invalid/dangling Paint pointer to be dereferenced; dispatch reads `u.format` (1-byte BEInt) from invalid memory, causing the UBSan SEGV seen in BEInt::operator unsigned char().
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered via hb-subset-fuzzer when input provides a malformed COLR v1 table (version==1 so closure_forV1 is executed) with crafted BaseGlyphV1 paint offsets/out-of-range structure references. Data flow: fuzzer input -> face tables -> hb_subset_plan_create() -> _populate_gids_to_retain() -> colr.closure_forV1(). If glyphset includes the referenced base glyph, closure_forV1 follows the bad paint offset and dispatches on invalid memory, producing the crash.
